title: Webhooks that merchants can rely on
summary: Tell merchants' servers about payments reliably, even when those servers are slow or down.
context: Jalebi Pay notifies 30,000 merchants by webhook when a payment succeeds. Many merchants' servers are slow or go down for hours. A slow merchant now holds up delivery to others, and merchants who miss a webhook do not ship the order.
A merchant must be able to confirm that a webhook really came from Jalebi Pay. Merchants' developers also need a way to see what was sent and why it failed.
must_handle: A slow or dead merchant does not delay anyone else.
A failed delivery is retried over a sensible period, then stops.
A merchant can verify the sender and reject a replay.
A repeated or out-of-order delivery can be handled by the merchant.
A merchant can see and resend past deliveries.
show_in_answer: How one event becomes delivery attempts.
How merchants are isolated from each other.
The payload and its headers, including how the signature works.
What the merchant's delivery log looks like.
